summary: Verified the fix for 'İptal butonu çalışmıyor' bug end-to-end. Backend PATCH /api/appointments/{id} (status=cancelled) and DELETE /api/appointments/{id} both return 200 with expected payloads. UI: on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844), the shadcn AlertDialog opens correctly (replacing the unreliable window.confirm), 'Vazgeç' closes without side effects, 'Evet, İptal Et' fires PATCH, moves the appointment to İptaller tab and shows the 'Randevu iptal edildi.' toast. In İptaller tab, 'Kalıcı Sil' shows a distinct confirm dialog ('Bu randevu KALICI olarak silinsin mi?'), confirms → row disappears and 'Randevu kalıcı olarak silindi.' toast shows. 5/5 pytest cases and 2/2 Playwright flows PASS.

issues: Table overflows horizontally so Müşteri/Hizmet/Tarih columns are scrolled off-screen; action buttons visible but user must scroll to see which appointment they're acting on. Not part of the current bug, but worth considering a responsive card layout for mobile in a future iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: Appointments.jsx line 159 still uses window.confirm for deleteContract() — same mobile-unreliability issue you just fixed for cancel/delete could bite here. Consider migrating that call to the same AlertDialog pattern.
server.py DELETE /appointments/{aid} always returns {ok:true} even when the id does not exist. Consider returning 404 when delete_one().deleted_count == 0 for better client-side error surfacing.
server.py is >1700 lines — recurring feedback across iterations; split into routers when time permits.
seed_data_creation: Registered ephemeral test customers (ui_cancel_*, ui_mob_*, test_cancel_*) and created ~3 pending appointments in 2026-09-12 / 2026-09-27 as fixtures. Two appointments were cancelled+hard-deleted end-of-test; the remaining cancelled ones can be cleaned up if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The AlertDialog confirm pattern (data-testid=confirm-dialog / confirm-ok / confirm-cancel) is reused for BOTH cancel and hard-delete via a single `confirmAction` state — future testing should assert the dialog title text differs between the two flows (İptal='Randevu iptal edilsin mi?' vs Delete='Bu randevu KALICI olarak silinsin mi?'). Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_cancel_delete_appointments.py and can be re-run as regression: `pytest backend/tests/test_cancel_delete_appointments.py`.
rca of the issue: Root cause: window.confirm() is unreliable in mobile browsers (some suppress it, some show generic native dialog that misfires) and the code referenced confirmAction state that was never declared, so on desktop cancel would either throw or silently no-op. Fix in Appointments.jsx: (1) added useState for confirmAction, (2) replaced both window.confirm calls in cancel() and hardDelete() with setConfirmAction({...}) that opens a shadcn <AlertDialog> at the bottom of the component. Verified 5 backend pytest + 2 Playwright flows (desktop 1920x1080, mobile 390x844).
